items.classification_note: This HKEX 'treasury shares' figure is 0 and is not the same label as the accounting 'Treasury shares' equity line of RMB (2,180) million in the 30 June 2026 condensed consolidated statement of financial position. The accounting line is consistent with shares already repurchased and still pending cancellation, which HKEX requires to remain in issued share capital until cancelled.

evidence: NDD Section I Part B as at the 30 June 2026 closing balance date, and Monthly Return remarks item 3.

NDD notes: if repurchased shares are to be cancelled after the closing balance date, they remain part of the issued shares as at the closing balance date in Part A and are disclosed in Part B.
